title: Royal Scratch Match
description: Standalone Crown & Cadence call-and-response rhythm knockout for 2–10 contestant slots, with rehearsal, musical count-in, timing soundcheck, persistent access settings, touch/keyboard/gamepad chords and seeded set replay. One local player plus bots by default; phone multiplayer is not integrated.
